meta.name: anndata
meta.description: Data structure for annotated matrices in single-cell analysis. Use when working with .h5ad files or integrating with the scverse ecosystem. This is the data format skill—for analysis workflows use scanpy; for probabilistic models use scvi-tools; for population-scale queries use cellxgene-census.

copy.tagline: 管理单细胞分析的注释数据矩阵
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常处理单细胞RNA-seq数据或.h5ad文件。
copy.tagline_en: Manage annotated matrices for single-cell analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with single-cell RNA-seq data or .h5ad files.

howto.what: Claude 可以创建和操作 AnnData 对象——一种带注释的矩阵数据结构。它能读取/写入 h5ad、zarr 等文件,筛选子集、拼接多个数据集,并支持 scanpy 等 scverse 工具配合使用。
howto.when: 当你要求处理 .h5ad 或 zarr 文件、做单细胞 RNA-seq 分析,或需要拼接/筛选带注释的数据时触发。

say.text: 读取 data.h5ad 并输出 obs 和 var 的列名。
say.note: Claude 用 anndata 读取并展示结构。

say.text: 用 backed 模式打开这个大文件,筛选后转成内存数据。
say.note: 适合超大文件,避免内存不足。

howto.what_en: Claude can create and manipulate AnnData objects, an annotated matrix data structure. It can read/write h5ad and zarr files, subset data, concatenate multiple datasets, and work with scanpy and other scverse tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to work with .h5ad or zarr files, perform single-cell RNA-seq analysis, or concatenate/subset annotated data.

say_en.text: Read data.h5ad and print the column names of obs and var.
say_en.note: Claude reads it with anndata and shows the structure.

say_en.text: Merge three batch h5ad files, add a batch label, use inner join.
Open this large file in backed mode, filter, then convert to memory.
say_en.note: Good for huge files to avoid out-of-memory.
